limitations: 本容器只列本地固定模型研究；不是實際可交易勝率或下單授權。
歷史資料截點與報告真實生成時間分開；不是回填當時已發布的預測。

q10至q90是名目期末區間；歷史涵蓋率另列，並非未來保證或期間觸價機率。
策略為原始價格價差扣假設成本，未含現金股息或空方股息補償，不是總報酬。
未確認實際空方資格、券源、費用與交易限制；借券年費敏感度是研究假設。
目標日沿用本股封存交易所日曆與臨時休市證據；不以平日規則改寫日期。

calibration.final_fit_policy: Previously evaluated origins may enter later fitting after maturity; labels must mature strictly before the current origin, exactly as in evaluation folds. No OOS score selects the algorithm.
calibration.method: Four-class Laplace KNN; shrink weight selected on each calibration phase only; fixed algorithm evaluated chronologically.

current_forecast.interpretation: New terminal-state event, independent of the old overlapping path scenarios.

model_specification.current_fit_policy: Same strict phase partition at current origin; labels maturing on T itself are conservatively excluded.
model_specification.fold_eligibility: Only source verification, never outcome or score, may exclude an evaluation fold.
model_specification.out_of_domain_policy: Horizon unavailable; no threshold clipping or relabelling.
model_specification.purge: H sessions at both phase boundaries

scoring_definition.brier_score: mean multiclass sum of squared errors over four states; range 0..2
scoring_definition.comparison_policy: Compare within this identical four-state event and cohort; raw scores are not directly comparable with the old three-class event.

source_metadata.adjusted_series_usage: diagnostic only, not selected for better performance
source_metadata.price_basis: raw closing-price events; excludes cash dividends and short distribution compensation; not total return

walk_forward_summary.note_zh: 每窗只用訓練截止前已出場的標籤選參；測試按訊號日歸窗，跨窗持有至固定期限。訊號可重疊，統計不是投組績效或獨立交易勝率。

limitations: 本容器只列本地固定模型研究；不是實際可交易勝率或下單授權。
歷史資料截點與報告真實生成時間分開；不是回填當時已發布的預測。
擴張窗口各折的訓練、校正與OOS期間可能重疊；不捏造一組整體互斥三段期間。
相鄰標籤重疊，非重疊子樣本仍不保證獨立；歷史OOS不保證未來優勢。
三方向、期末價格分位、期末四狀態、期間觸價與策略獲利是不同事件，不互換或加總。
q10至q90是名目期末區間；歷史涵蓋率另列，並非未來保證或期間觸價機率。
策略為原始價格價差扣假設成本，未含現金股息或空方股息補償，不是總報酬。
未確認實際空方資格、券源、費用與交易限制；借券年費敏感度是研究假設。
目標日沿用本股封存交易所日曆與臨時休市證據；不以平日規則改寫日期。
